modifiers.label: Weapons
modifiers.tip: Which weapons spawn and what players start with.

modifiers.label: Items
modifiers.tip: Which items spawn on the map.

modifiers.label: Physics
modifiers.tip: Movement rules. VQ3 is Quake 3's own bg_pmove.c; CPM adds air control and double jumps.

modifiers.label: Spawns
modifiers.tip: How spawn points are picked. Quake 3 picks randomly among the points farthest from the killer.

modifiers.label: Weapon respawn
modifiers.tip: Seconds before a picked-up weapon returns (g_weaponrespawn; team modes use 30).

modifiers.label: Friendly fire
modifiers.tip: Team modes: teammates can hurt each other.

modifiers.label: Overtime
modifiers.tip: What happens on a tie when time runs out.

capturelimit.label: Capture limit
capturelimit.tip: Flag captures to win. 0 = no limit.

timelimit.label: Time limit
timelimit.tip: Match length in minutes. 0 = no limit.

warmup.label: Warmup
warmup.tip: Warmup before the match starts. 0 = none.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.tip: Windowed, borderless full screen, or exclusive full screen (lowest latency).

schema.label: Window size
schema.tip: Window size in windowed mode. Full screen always uses the monitor's resolution; use Render scale to change the 3D resolution there.

schema.label: Monitor
schema.tip: Which monitor the game opens on.

schema.label: VSync
schema.tip: Off gives the lowest input latency. Adaptive syncs only when above the refresh rate.

schema.label: Frame cap
schema.tip: Maximum frames per second. 0 = uncapped. Physics runs at its own fixed rate, so the cap never changes movement (no 125 fps jump quirk).

schema.label: Field of view
schema.tip: Horizontal degrees at 4:3, like Quake 3's cg_fov. Wider screens see more at the sides (Hor+), so it's correct at any aspect.

schema.label: Render scale
schema.tip: 3D resolution relative to the window. The menu and HUD always render at full resolution.

schema.label: Upscaler
schema.tip: How the 3D image is scaled when render scale isn't 1.

schema.label: Brightness
schema.tip: Overall brightness of the 3D image.

schema.label: Contrast
schema.tip: Contrast of the 3D image.

schema.label: Preset
schema.tip: Sets every quality setting below. Classic keeps Quake 3's look (no SSR, AO, bloom, fog or shimmer). Changing one of them switches this to Custom.

schema.label: Shadows
schema.tip: Shadow map resolution and filtering. Ultra also gives every map light a live shadow on players and the mist: barely visible, and several times slower.

schema.label: Global illumination
schema.tip: Real-time bounce light (SDFGI). Maps are relit in-engine instead of using baked lightmaps.

schema.label: Screen-space reflections
schema.tip: Reflections on wet and polished floors.

schema.label: Ambient occlusion
schema.tip: Contact shadows in corners and creases (SSAO).

schema.label: Volumetric fog
schema.tip: Light shafts and the menu's drifting smoke.

schema.label: Bloom
schema.tip: Glow around bright light and energy weapons.

schema.label: Anti-aliasing
schema.tip: Smooths jagged edges. TAA is smoothest but softens motion.

schema.label: Anisotropic filtering
schema.tip: Sharpness of textures seen at an angle.

schema.label: Texture quality
schema.tip: Lower settings use smaller mipmaps (less video memory).

schema.label: Model detail
schema.tip: How soon distant models switch to simpler meshes.

schema.label: Particles
schema.tip: Amount of smoke, sparks and embers.

schema.label: Effect intensity
schema.tip: Brightness of explosions, beams, flashes and their lights.

schema.label: Heat shimmer
schema.tip: Air ripples behind rockets and around explosions.

schema.label: Marks and decals
schema.tip: Bullet holes, burns and blood on walls.

schema.label: Gibs
schema.tip: Bodies burst into gibs on big hits (cg_gibs). Off: they burn away instead.

schema.label: Master
schema.tip: Master volume.

schema.label: Music
schema.tip: Music volume.

schema.label: Effects
schema.tip: Effects volume.

schema.label: Voice chat
schema.tip: Voice chat volume.

schema.label: Announcer
schema.tip: Announcer volume.

schema.label: Menu sounds
schema.tip: Menu sounds volume.

schema.label: Menu music
schema.tip: Quake 3's soundtrack, shuffled, in the main menu.

schema.label: Menu ambience
schema.tip: A quiet ambient drone in the menu. Quake 3's menu had no music, so it's off by default.

schema.label: Mute when in background
schema.tip: Silence the game while its window isn't focused.

schema.label: Output device
schema.tip: Where sound plays.

schema.label: Voice chat device
schema.tip: Microphone for voice chat.

schema.label: Hit sound
schema.tip: The beep when you hit an enemy. Pitch by damage beeps higher for small hits and lower for big ones.

schema.label: Spatial audio
schema.tip: Distant sounds are muffled and placed more sharply left and right. Off is Quake 3's plain stereo panning.

schema.label: Announcer
schema.tip: The voice: "Excellent!", "Impressive!", lead changes, warnings, the countdown and "Fight!".

schema.tip: Binds for player list: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: HUD on / off
schema.tip: Binds for hud on / off: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Name tags
schema.tip: Binds for name tags: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Outlines
schema.tip: Binds for outlines: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Hide the controls
schema.tip: Binds for hide the controls: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Clip start
schema.tip: Binds for clip start: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Clip end
schema.tip: Binds for clip end: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Export the clip
schema.tip: Binds for export the clip: two for keyboard/mouse, one for the controller. Click and press a key, mouse button, wheel or pad button.

schema.label: Toggle crouch
schema.tip: Tap to crouch instead of holding.

schema.label: Toggle zoom
schema.tip: Tap to zoom instead of holding.

schema.label: Stick deadzone
schema.tip: Controller stick deadzone, menus included.

schema.label: Stick look speed
schema.tip: Controller look speed at full tilt, in turns per second.

schema.label: Stick layout
schema.tip: Which controller stick moves and which looks.

schema.label: Sensitivity
schema.tip: Quake 3 units: degrees per count = sensitivity x 0.022 (m_yaw). The cm/360 below is the distance for a full turn.

schema.label: Mouse DPI
schema.tip: Your mouse's DPI (counts per inch). Only used to show cm/360.

schema.label: Zoom sensitivity
schema.tip: Multiplier while zoomed.

schema.label: Acceleration
schema.tip: Quake 3's cl_mouseAccel: faster swipes turn further. 0 = off. Mouse look always reads the mouse raw, without Windows' pointer speed.

schema.label: Invert vertical
schema.tip: Mouse up looks down.

schema.label: Crosshair
schema.tip: Quake 3's ten crosshairs or a vector shape.

schema.label: Size
schema.tip: Size in pixels at 1080p (cg_crosshairSize).

schema.label: Thickness
schema.tip: Line thickness of vector shapes.

schema.label: Gap
schema.tip: Space in the middle of vector shapes.

schema.label: Center dot
schema.tip: Adds a dot in the middle.

schema.label: Color
schema.tip: Crosshair color.

schema.label: Outline
schema.tip: Dark outline so it reads on bright walls.

schema.label: Hit color
schema.tip: Flashes this color when you hit an enemy.

schema.label: Color by health
schema.tip: Quake 3's cg_crosshairHealth: tint by your health.

schema.label: Per-weapon crosshairs
schema.tip: Use a different crosshair for each weapon.

schema.label: Gauntlet
schema.tip: Crosshair for the gauntlet when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Machine gun
schema.tip: Crosshair for the machine gun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Shotgun
schema.tip: Crosshair for the shotgun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Grenade launcher
schema.tip: Crosshair for the grenade launcher when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Rocket launcher
schema.tip: Crosshair for the rocket launcher when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Lightning gun
schema.tip: Crosshair for the lightning gun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Railgun
schema.tip: Crosshair for the railgun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: Plasma gun
schema.tip: Crosshair for the plasma gun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: BFG10K
schema.tip: Crosshair for the bfg10k when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

schema.label: HUD preset
schema.tip: Layout of the HUD: Modern (glass panels and bars), Competitive (smaller, compact), Minimal (numbers only), or Quake 3 classic (ammo, health and armor in one row).

schema.label: HUD scale
schema.tip: Size of the HUD.

schema.label: HUD opacity
schema.tip: Transparency of the HUD.

schema.label: Speedometer
schema.tip: Your speed in units per second, with the strafe-jump readout (speed at each takeoff and the gain on the last).

schema.label: Speedometer style
schema.tip: Arc gauge or a compact bar. The Competitive and Quake 3 classic presets always use the compact bar.

schema.label: Item timers
schema.tip: Countdowns for the armors, Mega Health and powerups once they're taken, left of the screen.

schema.label: Damage numbers
schema.tip: Damage dealt floats over the target.

schema.label: Kill feed
schema.tip: Who killed whom, top right.

schema.label: Ammo bar
schema.tip: Ammo for every weapon along the bottom.

schema.label: Net graph
schema.tip: Quake 3's lagometer, bottom right: frame timing above, snapshot ping below, with ping and frame time.

schema.label: Show FPS
schema.tip: Frame rate counter.

schema.label: Chat time
schema.tip: How long chat lines stay on screen. The chat key shows the recent history.

schema.label: Chat lines
schema.tip: Most chat lines shown at once while playing.

schema.label: Team chat only
schema.tip: Hide everyone's chat but your team's (cg_teamChatsOnly).

schema.label: Switch on pickup
schema.tip: Switch to a weapon you pick up (cg_autoswitch).

schema.label: Gun position
schema.tip: Where your gun is drawn (cg_drawGun).

schema.label: Gun field of view
schema.tip: Field of view the gun is drawn at. 0 draws it at your Field of view, as Quake 3 does.

schema.label: Widescreen gun placement
schema.tip: Keep the gun as far toward the edge as Quake 3 drew it on a 4:3 screen. Off draws it where a wide screen puts it, nearer the middle.

schema.label: Gun side offset
schema.tip: Moves the gun sideways (cg_gunY): toward the edge its side is on, or back toward the middle.

schema.label: View bob
schema.tip: The view bobs as you run (cg_bobup/cg_bobpitch).

schema.label: Force enemy model
schema.tip: Show every enemy as one model (cg_forceModel).

schema.label: Bright skins
schema.tip: Players drawn in one flat bright color: enemies in Enemy color, teammates in Team color.

schema.label: Enemy color
schema.tip: Bright skin color for enemies.

schema.label: Team color
schema.tip: Bright skin color for teammates.

schema.label: Spawn effects
schema.tip: Teleport flash when players spawn and teleport.

schema.label: Hit twitch
schema.tip: Players' upper bodies jerk to the side when they're hit, as in Quake 3 (CG_AddPainTwitch). Off keeps them steady.

schema.label: Intro movie
schema.tip: Quake 3's id logo and intro when the game starts.

schema.label: Tier movies
schema.tip: Play Quake 3's tier movie when you finish a campaign tier.

schema.label: Record replays
schema.tip: Record every match you play: the whole match, every player, watchable from any view (Play > Replays).

schema.label: Replays kept
schema.tip: How many recent replays stay. Older ones are deleted, except favorites, which stay forever.

schema.label: Death cam
schema.tip: While you're dead the camera follows your body, then shows who killed you with their player card. Respawning works as in Quake 3.

schema.label: Spectator camera
schema.tip: How you see the player you follow while spectating: through their eyes, the chase camera behind them, or the cinematic camera, which picks its own shots (slow orbits, tracking shots, wide shots of the fight) and cuts to the action, with the auto-director choosing who to watch. Use item switches between them.

schema.label: Auto-director
schema.tip: While you spectate, the camera follows the action by itself: a flag carrier, whoever just fragged, the closest fight. Gesture turns it on and off.

schema.label: Region
schema.tip: Matchmaking region, and the Server Browser's first choice. Automatic finds matches in your closest region first and widens if the wait runs long; a named region stays strict.

schema.label: Max ping
schema.tip: Hide servers and matches above this ping (the Server Browser's filter).

schema.label: Interpolation
schema.tip: Delay before other players are drawn in an online match, which smooths their motion. Lower is sharper, higher is smoother.

schema.label: Connection speed
schema.tip: Bandwidth a server may send you (your rate userinfo).

schema.label: Online services
schema.tip: Friends, parties and presence. Off keeps you offline.

schema.label: Online server
schema.tip: Leave empty for the default. A local test server is ws://127.0.0.1:8787.

schema.label: Allow direct map downloads
schema.tip: When a match is on a map one of you doesn't have, send or get it over a direct connection between the two PCs instead of through the relay. While it runs, the other player (or server) sees your IP address; the match itself always stays on the relay. Both sides need this on (dedicated servers always allow it).

schema.label: Check for updates
schema.tip: Ask GitHub when the menu opens whether a newer version has been released, and offer it. The game never installs anything without asking.

schema.label: Include beta releases
schema.tip: Also offer pre-releases. A beta build is always offered newer betas.

schema.label: Menu and text size
schema.tip: Size of the menu, text and HUD.

schema.label: High-contrast menus
schema.tip: Solid backgrounds and brighter text in menus.

schema.label: Reduced flashing
schema.tip: Calms pulsing, embers, muzzle flashes and screen flashes.

schema.label: Colorblind mode
schema.tip: Shifts the game's colors so the ones your eyes confuse stay apart (a daltonize filter over the 3D and the HUD).

schema.label: Subtitles
schema.tip: Captions for the announcer, bottom middle.

schema.label: Subtitle size
schema.tip: Caption text size.

schema.label: Player name
schema.tip: Your name in matches.

schema.label: Character
schema.tip: Your character.

schema.label: Skin
schema.tip: Your character's skin. Team games paint you red or blue.

schema.label: Accent color
schema.tip: Your color: the menu's rim light and your rail trail.
